ideas.pitch: An AI-powered documentation auditing and PR generation tool designed specifically to help open-source maintainers triage outdated READMEs and missing docstrings.
ideas.title: OpenDoc Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on open-source community pain points of documentation upkeep, aligning with open-source contribution program goals.

ideas.pitch: A smart repository onboarding assistant that automatically maps out codebase architecture for first-time contributors and labels good-first-issues using AST parsing.
ideas.title: IssueFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly facilitates real-world software development and open-source collaboration by reducing onboarding friction for new contributors.

ideas.pitch: An analytics platform that helps maintainers visualize contributor health, PR merge latency, and review bottlenecks across their open-source repositories.
ideas.title: GitMetrics Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides tangible utility for project maintainers managing large influxes of open-source contributions during event cycles.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight GitHub Action that automatically checks pull requests for common anti-patterns, missing tests, and style violations, leaving inline review comments.
ideas.title: PR Review Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Automates repetitive maintenance tasks, showcasing practical software engineering workflows that judges appreciate.

ideas.pitch: A recommendation engine that matches developer skill profiles with open-source issues tailored to their exact tech stack and experience level.
ideas.title: OSS Skill Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Encourages participation by solving discovery friction for participants looking to make meaningful contributions quickly.
